scriptSource:
"""syzygy-bpyt.8.3 premise check: does the v1.2 local-agent-mode change, as signed, carry a scenario that requires a refusal while
v1.2 is unsigned? Sweeps every tracked file of the change in the tree given, classifies every sign-off hit by file and line, and tests
every scenario block of the spec delta with three predicates. Fails (AssertionError) when the hit set drifts from the classified set.
Before the real sweep it runs each predicate against a mutated copy of the same texts and records that the mutant is caught.
Usage: python3 premise_check.py <tree> <out.json>"""
import json, re, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

TREE, OUT = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(), Path(sys.argv[2])
CHANGE = 'openspec/changes/polaris-dossier-local-agent-mode/'
SPEC = CHANGE + 'specs/polaris-generation/spec.md'
DIRECTION = '.syzygy/governance/decisions/POLARIS-DOSSIER-WAITING-SESSIONS-DIRECTION.md'
RECORD = '.syzygy/governance/decisions/POLARIS-DOSSIER-LOCAL-AGENT-MODE-SIGNOFF-v1.2.md'

# Sign-off vocabulary: case folded, word-bounded so "assigned" and "designed" do not match.
SIGNOFF = re.compile(r'\b(?:un)?signed\b|\bsign-?offs?\b|\bsignoff\b|until the owner|version-tagged', re.I)
# Refusal vocabulary, for the second scenario predicate.
REFUSAL = re.compile(r'refus|\bSHALL NOT\b|\bnot started\b|\bstops?\b|\bfails?\b', re.I)
# A scenario that conditions on the change's own version or its sign-off would name one of these.
VERSIONED = re.compile(r'\b1\.[012]\b|\bversion\b|\bv1\b|\bsign', re.I)

ID = 'owner-direction or decision identifier (the token is part of a name, not a condition)'
BANNER = 'binding or history banner: which versions were signed, and that these bytes bind only by sign-off'
SEQUENCE = 'sequencing: what is installed, implemented or put to the owner at or after the sign-off'
CLASSIFIED = {
    ('GOVERNING-DEPENDENCIES.md', 25): ID,
    ('design.md', 4): BANNER, ('design.md', 6): BANNER, ('design.md', 8): SEQUENCE, ('design.md', 67): ID,
    ('design.md', 222): BANNER, ('design.md', 305): SEQUENCE, ('design.md', 416): SEQUENCE,
    ('proposal.md', 9): ID, ('proposal.md', 10): ID, ('proposal.md', 15): BANNER, ('proposal.md', 21): BANNER,
    ('proposal.md', 120): BANNER, ('proposal.md', 151): SEQUENCE, ('proposal.md', 159): SEQUENCE, ('proposal.md', 185): SEQUENCE,
    ('spec.md', 3): BANNER, ('spec.md', 11): ID, ('spec.md', 223): ID, ('spec.md', 320): ID, ('spec.md', 414): ID,
    ('tasks.md', 14): SEQUENCE, ('tasks.md', 19): SEQUENCE, ('tasks.md', 25): SEQUENCE, ('tasks.md', 26): SEQUENCE,
    ('tasks.md', 27): ID, ('tasks.md', 30): SEQUENCE, ('tasks.md', 32): SEQUENCE, ('tasks.md', 99): SEQUENCE,
}
DIRECTION_LINES = (89, 91)
DIRECTION_TEXT = ('   The code may merge only once version 1.2 is signed off: until then the\n'
                  '   signed version 1.1 says each session is handed its packet when the\n'
                  '   operator starts it.\n')
# The selftest's planted scenario, placed after the waiting-session scenario at the head of REQ-035's waiting block.
PLANTED = ['', '#### Scenario: Waiting session before the owner has signed version 1.2', '',
           '- **WHEN** the operator runs `session-prompt <run> all` while version 1.2 is unsigned',
           '- **THEN** the command is refused and each session is handed its packet as in version 1.1']


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(TREE), *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout


def sweep(texts):
    """texts: {tracked path: text}. Returns the classified hits, the spec's requirements and scenarios, and the summary."""
    hits = []
    for f, text in texts.items():
        for n, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
            tokens = [m.group() for m in SIGNOFF.finditer(line)]
            if tokens:
                hits.append({'file': f, 'line': n, 'tokens': tokens, 'class': CLASSIFIED.get((Path(f).name, n))})
    found = {(Path(h['file']).name, h['line']) for h in hits}
    assert found == set(CLASSIFIED), f'unclassified {sorted(found - set(CLASSIFIED))}; no longer hit {sorted(set(CLASSIFIED) - found)}'
    spec = texts[SPEC].splitlines()
    requirements = [(n, l[len('### Requirement: '):]) for n, l in enumerate(spec, 1) if l.startswith('### Requirement: ')]
    scenarios = []
    for n, line in enumerate(spec, 1):
        if line.startswith('#### Scenario: '):
            end = next((m for m in range(n, len(spec)) if spec[m].startswith(('#', 'Form: ', '```'))), len(spec))
            body = spec[n - 1:end]
            scenarios.append({
                'line': n, 'lastLine': end, 'requirement': [r for r in requirements if r[0] < n][-1][1], 'title': line[len('#### Scenario: '):],
                'signoffVocabulary': [m.group() for l in body for m in SIGNOFF.finditer(l)],
                'refusalVocabulary': sorted({m.group() for l in body for m in REFUSAL.finditer(l)}),
                'versionOrSignoffVocabulary': [m.group() for l in body for m in VERSIONED.finditer(l)],
            })
    for h in hits:
        if h['file'] == SPEC:
            h['inScenario'] = next((s['title'] for s in scenarios if s['line'] <= h['line'] <= s['lastLine']), None)
    refusing = [s for s in scenarios if s['refusalVocabulary']]
    flagged = [s['title'] for s in refusing if s['signoffVocabulary'] or s['versionOrSignoffVocabulary']]
    summary = {
        'files': len(texts), 'requirements': len(requirements), 'scenarios': len(scenarios),
        'signoffHits': len(hits), 'signoffHitLines': len(found),
        'byClass': {c: sum(h['class'] == c for h in hits) for c in (ID, BANNER, SEQUENCE)},
        'hitsInsideAScenario': sum(h.get('inScenario') is not None for h in hits),
        'scenariosWithSignoffVocabulary': sum(bool(s['signoffVocabulary']) for s in scenarios),
        'scenariosWithRefusalVocabulary': len(refusing),
        'ofThoseNamingAVersionOrSignoff': len(flagged),
        'refusalScenariosNamingAVersionOrSignoff': flagged,
    }
    return hits, requirements, scenarios, summary


def selftest(texts):
    """Rule 6: each predicate, mutated in its input, must change the outcome."""
    results = []
    spec = texts[SPEC].splitlines()
    at = next(n for n, l in enumerate(spec) if l == '#### Scenario: Packet delivered to a waiting session') - 1
    planted = {**texts, SPEC: '\n'.join(spec[:at] + PLANTED + spec[at:]) + '\n'}
    try:
        sweep(planted)
        results.append({'mutant': 'a planted unsigned-refusal scenario', 'caught': False})
    except AssertionError as error:
        results.append({'mutant': 'a planted unsigned-refusal scenario', 'caught': True, 'by': 'the hit-set assertion', 'firstError': str(error).splitlines()[0]})
    # The same plant with the classification widened to accept it: the scenario predicates must catch it on their own.
    added = {(Path(SPEC).name, at + 1 + i): 'planted' for i, l in enumerate(PLANTED) if SIGNOFF.search(l)}
    shifted = {(k[0], k[1] + (len(PLANTED) if k[0] == Path(SPEC).name and k[1] > at else 0)): v for k, v in CLASSIFIED.items()}
    saved = dict(CLASSIFIED)
    CLASSIFIED.clear(); CLASSIFIED.update({**shifted, **added})
    try:
        summary = sweep(planted)[3]
    finally:
        CLASSIFIED.clear(); CLASSIFIED.update(saved)
    results.append({'mutant': 'the planted scenario with its hit lines classified', 'caught': summary['ofThoseNamingAVersionOrSignoff'] == 1
                    and summary['scenariosWithSignoffVocabulary'] == 1 and summary['hitsInsideAScenario'] == len(added),
                    'summary': {k: summary[k] for k in ('scenariosWithSignoffVocabulary', 'hitsInsideAScenario', 'ofThoseNamingAVersionOrSignoff',
                                                        'refusalScenariosNamingAVersionOrSignoff')}})
    # A hit removed from a classified line: the assertion must name it as no longer hit.
    first = texts[SPEC].splitlines()
    first[2] = SIGNOFF.sub('X', first[2])
    try:
        sweep({**texts, SPEC: '\n'.join(first) + '\n'})
        results.append({'mutant': 'every sign-off token removed from spec.md line 3', 'caught': False})
    except AssertionError as error:
        results.append({'mutant': 'every sign-off token removed from spec.md line 3', 'caught': True, 'by': 'the hit-set assertion', 'firstError': str(error).splitlines()[0]})
    return results


files = [f for f in git('ls-files', '-z', '--', CHANGE).split('\0') if f]
assert git('status', '--porcelain', '--', CHANGE, DIRECTION, RECORD) == '', 'the swept files differ from the commit'
texts = {f: (TREE / f).read_text(encoding='utf8') for f in files}
mutants = selftest(texts)
assert all(m['caught'] for m in mutants), mutants
hits, requirements, scenarios, summary = sweep(texts)
summary['scenariosRequiringARefusalWhileV12IsUnsigned'] = 0 if summary['ofThoseNamingAVersionOrSignoff'] == 0 and summary['hitsInsideAScenario'] == 0 else None

direction = (TREE / DIRECTION).read_text(encoding='utf8').splitlines(keepends=True)
quoted = ''.join(direction[DIRECTION_LINES[0] - 1:DIRECTION_LINES[1]])
assert quoted == DIRECTION_TEXT, quoted
record = (TREE / RECORD).read_text(encoding='utf8').splitlines()
head = {k: next(l.split(': ', 1)[1] for l in record if l.startswith(k + ': ')) for k in ('Date', 'Package', 'Version', 'Tag', 'Kind', 'Review', 'Reviewed commit')}

out = {
    'title': 'syzygy-bpyt.8.3 premise check: no scenario in the v1.2 local-agent-mode change requires a refusal while v1.2 is unsigned',
    'bead': 'syzygy-bpyt.8.3',
    'tree': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip(),
    'subject': {f: {'gitBlob': git('hash-object', '--', f).strip()} for f in files},
    'command': 'python3 premise_check.py <tree> <out.json>',
    'predicates': {
        'signoffVocabulary': SIGNOFF.pattern + ' (re.I), over every line of every file in subject',
        'refusalVocabulary': REFUSAL.pattern + ' (re.I), over every scenario block of ' + SPEC,
        'versionOrSignoffVocabulary': VERSIONED.pattern + ' (re.I), over every scenario block of ' + SPEC,
        'scenarioBlock': "from a line starting '#### Scenario: ' to the line before the next line starting '#', 'Form: ' or a fence; "
                         "a requirement's last scenario is followed by its Form, verification block and warrants, which are not scenario text",
    },
    'selftest': mutants,
    'summary': summary,
    'signoffHits': hits,
    'requirements': [{'line': n, 'title': t} for n, t in requirements],
    'scenarios': scenarios,
    'mergeRule': {'file': DIRECTION, 'lines': list(DIRECTION_LINES), 'text': DIRECTION_TEXT,
                  'reading': 'a rule on when the code may merge, discharged by the v1.2 sign-off below; it states no runtime refusal'},
    'v12SignoffRecordHead': {'file': RECORD, **head},
    'scriptSource': Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'selftest': mutants, 'summary': summary}, indent=1))
